fields.title: Protecting the work area
fields.content: Before you start, lay drop sheets over floors and furniture near the work area. Move small items out of the way with the homeowner's permission. Close off the area if children or pets are at home. Bring your own cleaning cloths, and never use the homeowner's towels.

fields.title: Explaining the fault and price before starting
fields.content: Inspect the fault and explain in plain language what is wrong and what you will do. Confirm the price on the job matches the quotation the homeowner accepted. If the work will cost more, stop and add a part line in the app before going further. Never start extra work the homeowner has not approved.

fields.title: Photographing the work
fields.content: Take at least one clear photo of the fault before you begin and one of the finished work afterwards. Photos protect both you and the homeowner if a warranty claim is raised. The app will not let you mark a job Completed without them.

fields.title: Recording parts with receipts
fields.content: Every replacement part must be added to the job with its name, price and a photo of the receipt. Parts that take the job above the predicted range are checked by FixItFast staff, and your payout for that part is held until the receipt is approved.

fields.title: Leaving the site clean
fields.content: Remove all debris, old parts and packaging unless the homeowner asks to keep them. Wipe down surfaces you worked on and return moved items. Walk the homeowner through the finished work before you mark the job Completed.

fields.option_b: Lay drop sheets and move small items with permission
